how_to_check: sh tools/verify-package.sh <this directory> checks every digest below, that no file in the package is missing from SHA256SUMS, and that SHA256SUMS.sig verifies against the repository's SIGNING_KEYS. npm run walk recomputes every sha256 in this manifest from the file beside it. Neither says the contents are true; statement.md says what they do and do not show.
